admission_sequence.no_live_weight_until: custody record has admitted raw package and hash/copy checks pass
blocked_overclaim: redacted shell used as raw artifact

admission_sequence.no_live_weight_until: authority is class-specific and dependency group is mapped
blocked_overclaim: result-return authority reused for independent review

admission_sequence.no_live_weight_until: response is verified and intake is admitted through external receipt intake

admission_sequence.creates_or_updates: actual-receipt-import-gate, challenge/rollback record if contested, class-local replay, computed-floor snapshot
admission_sequence.no_live_weight_until: computed snapshot and invariant report accept a passed import gate
blocked_overclaim: single class-local import treated as cross-critical quorum

no_go_conditions: fieldkit has no raw live artifact attached
any required slot missing or failed
class-specific authority absent or reused across receipt classes
computed-floor snapshot and invariant replay disagree
allowed_next_records: counterparty-artifact-custody-record only after raw package exists
failed-gate-public-summary if any required slot fails
no response/intake/import gate until custody and authority screens pass
public_summary_requirements: state that no live artifact has been admitted yet
publish failed-gate branches without sealed details
state that fieldkit readiness is not receipt satisfaction
